name: Hunting Challenge
author: Addicting Games
description: Hunting Challenge is a free target practice game. Clay Pigeons are for the weak. in the real world, the toughest of the tough hunt real ducks. In Hunting Challenge, you will be locking loading and unleashing your buckshot into the skies of the great outdoors as you try to down birds. The birds move fast and fly at all kinds of weird crazy angles. You will need the speed, the accuracy, and the iron will of determined focus in order to bring down these crazy birds. As you blow through your ammo you're going to need to re-load. Don't worry we got you covered. If and when you run out of ammo just point your gun at the bottom of the screen and fire to load. Then lock load, and let go as you blast off into the wild blue yonder. take down as many birds as you can in this devastatingly simple and classic target-practice style game. This is a fascinating game of cat and mouse, bird and gun, and bullet and sky. It is up to you to use your trigger finger to put those bullets into the sky and get those dang birds.
